use_case: Use the checklist during construction warranty claim intake and disposition when the warranty claim record must identify installed asset, serial or model, location, installer, completion date, warranty terms, and prior service. Complete the applicable handoff for coverage decision, repair record, parts disposition, customer verification, recurrence monitoring, and warranty history.
